business: Atulya Ventures Pvt Ltd is a rural development company that offers a model called AURUM to connect rural entrepreneurs with urban investors, providing financial products and services to underserved retail customers and acting as a business model provider across sectors such as financial services, entertainment, e‑governance, travel, and utility bills.
customers: The company serves unserved and underserved rural retail customers, rural entrepreneurs who act as distribution channels, and urban investors who invest in the captured market.
